assessment_summary.project_name: Data Center Rack Cooling Fan Selection
assessment_summary.cou_name: Fan selection at 1.20 m³/s, 325 Pa in AMCA 210 plenum

evidence_keywords: All meshes, case/data files, and scripts are in Git with semantic version tags
CI job runs a small regression case nightly to flag solver environment drift
Fluent build hash logged
Boundary naming and frame definitions are tested by a script
laminar Poiseuille flow case (3D rectangular duct) with an analytical pressure gradient
rotating cavity (simplified lid-driven rotor) verifying frame transformations
turbulent channel at Re_τ ≈ 395 comparing skin friction
Ansys’ published method of manufactured solutions (MMS)
A three-level mesh refinement study was performed
5.2M cells (coarse), 8.7M (medium), 14.6M (fine)
apparent order p ≈ 2.1 for Δp
estimated remaining grid uncertainty on Δp at the fine mesh is 1.2%
Residuals reach 10^-6 in all equations
torque and Δp plateaus achieved over the final 500 iterations
Mass imbalance < 0.05%
ramped outlet pressure and swirl correction to avoid false convergence
37-point rotating CFD checklist was followed
Sign-off by independent reviewer (J. Yuan)
hash-based checks to prevent accidental changes in boundary assignments
linter script (converts any mm entries to m and flags rogue unit entries)
Steady RANS; MRF in the rotor cell zone
Turbulence model: Baseline: SST k–ω with curvature correction
RSM was used as a check
Compressibility: Ignored (Ma < 0.3 rule of thumb)
we assign a modeling component of ±1.5% (covering both)
Geometry from vendor CAD (STEP, Rev. K)
cross-checked against physical part using CMM
Tip clearance measured with feeler gauges
Inlet turbulence intensity measured in the test duct with a hot-wire
Air properties derived from lab logs
Each operating point measured in triplicate
standard deviation in Δp < 0.7% of mean
flow rate repeatability < 0.6%
AMCA 210-16 test conducted in Epsilon’s Lab 2
Arrangement 1 (free inlet)
Air density corrections per AMCA
swirl angle at the nozzle plane < 5°
We modeled the plenum, bellmouth, and measurement section
density set per test condition for paired comparisons
Total pressure inlet with measured turbulence intensity (baseline 1.0% ± 0.5%)
Rotational speed: Validated at 1200, 1400, 1600, and 1800 RPM
The predicted Δp at 1600 RPM and Q = 1.20 m³/s is 332 Pa
The test mean is 327 Pa
mean absolute deviation between CFD and test across eight points is 2.3%
Torque prediction within 2.6% of back-calculated test torque

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: Determine if the fan satisfies Δp ≥ 325 Pa at Q = 1.20 m³/s with 10% margin
pressure-flow (P–Q) curve
special emphasis at 1600 RPM

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
evidence_keywords: in an AMCA 210 setup
Validated at 1200, 1400, 1600, and 1800 RPM
within the validated envelope; no extrapolation is required for the selection decision

expected_decision.outcome_source: we recommend selecting the next higher RPM setting (1650 RPM nominal)
rationale_keywords: Given the narrow margin to the target
both the model and test are within a few pascals of the target
